title: Sketchpad Design Scene From Elements
description: Replace the 3D scene in compose/sketchpad design app with the scene from elements (@elements/scene via TopologyScenePane). Wire representations, selection, hover, drag-drop, and relocate; remove dead legacy ComposeScene path.
summary: Stabilized `schema_gap_surfaces` gap macros via `.repo/finalize-and-build.py` (inlined name lists, `@do_register_bridge`, `::paste::paste!`, exported `gap_surface_families`/`gap_surface_existing_relays`). Known-good snapshot: `.repo/lib.rs.good` (~735KB). Restored truncated/corrupt `lib.rs` multiple times from HEAD; concurrent edits on `lib.rs` remain a blocker. Wasm pkg restored to ~14MB (`@compose/rs:build` green). `cargo build --lib` green with good snapshot. `@compose/sketchpad:build` green. `@elements/scene:test` and `@elements/topology:test` green. `@compose/sketchpad:test` fails when nx rebuilds `@compose/rs:build` after macro regressions on disk. Sketchpad Design uses `TopologyScenePane` from `@elements/scene`; no `react-flow` in sketchpad tests. Freed ~16GB disk (was 0 bytes).
